input.content: Pattern (P1, independently released client/provider): a client increment starts requiring a new response field (e.g. an `applied` receipt) that only a pending provider task will emit. The supported released provider omits the field, so every call fails, even when the request was actually applied and even with the feature flag off. The unit-test fixture is often rewritten to the unreleased response shape at the same time, which removes the only released-provider coverage and hides the regression. Review check: compare the client's required response fields against the released provider source at the supported tag. Accept the absent field from the legacy shape while still rejecting explicit negative values. Keep a test using the exact released response. Tighten to mandatory only after the baseline moves.
